coordinate_contract.axes: Java rig: +y up, front -z; generated item pixels are Minecraft model coordinates
coordinate_contract.matrix_convention: row-major 4x4; column vectors; no additional transform after importing parts[].vertices
coordinate_contract.weights: Each wedge has weight 1 on original J_R_Weapon source skin joint id 16. Map by bone id/name into the existing rig.
coordinate_contract.import_rule: Append only parts[0] and the existing texture to the original body rig. bones[] is correspondence context, do not create duplicate bones.
coordinate_contract.weapon_geometry: Direct client ItemModelGenerator.processFrames + FaceInfo/BlockElementFace UV corners; no authored replacement model.
coordinate_contract.attachment_scope: Dungeons socket placement is source evidence; mapping the existing Java weapon holder basis to it is an explicit cross-game adapter.

binding.socket_relative_transform_note: Socket serializes only SocketName and BoneName; no nondefault relative translation/rotation/scale override. Identity socket-to-bone uses standard engine defaults.
binding.adapter_choice: Use actual J_R_Weapon origin instead of the old fixed vanilla arm-to-grip translation; keep the existing Java held basis and original item thirdperson transform.
